data.name: Sui Southern Gas Company Limited
data.description: Sui Southern Gas Company Limited ("the Company") is a public limited Company incorporated in Pakistan under the Companies Act, 2017 (repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984) and is listed on Pakistan Stock Exchange. The Company came into being on March 30, 1989 after the amalgamation of Karachi Gas Company, Indus Gas Company and Sui Gas Transmission Company. The main activity of the Company is transmission and distribution of natural gas in Sindh and Balochistan. The Company is also engaged in certain activities related to the gas business including the manufacturing and sale of gas meters, LPG air mix and construction contracts for laying of pipelines.
